statement: Multi-modal and retrieval-augmented KV cache optimization is largely unaddressed as a joint problem. KVLink tackles RAG cache reuse but treats documents as text; LMCache handles storage/movement but is modality-agnostic. How vision/audio encoder KV caches (with different dimensionality, attention patterns, and compression tolerance) should be evicted, quantized, or reused alongside text KV — and whether cross-modal KV can be jointly compressed — is not characterized by the retained landscape. The contract explicitly names multi-modal KV cache as an open problem and the retained corpus provides no primary evidence on it.
